title: No Trace Chat – Secret Chat
fullDescription:
No Trace Chat — the disappearing messages app where you share a code and you’re in. No sign-up, no email, no phone number. Messages vanish after read. End-to-end encrypted, disposable chat by design. A secret chat app without phone number — and an app that deletes messages after read.

Create a room with a unique code or scan a QR code to join. Invite one person or a group — only people with the code can see the conversation. Messages are marked as deleted after being seen and disappear from the chat. No permanent record, no paper trail, no metadata stored.

🔒 Why people choose No Trace Chat

• Disappearing messages — Messages vanish after read. No timer to set, no toggle to remember. The chat that doesn’t stick around.
• No phone number, no account — Create or join a room in seconds. No email, no sign-up, no profile to leak. Chat without phone number, by design.
• End-to-end encrypted — Secure messaging where your conversations stay private. We don’t store messages after they’re read.
• Code-based rooms — Share a code or QR; only people with the code can join. Private chat rooms with code entry. Works for private one-on-one or group chat.
• Screenshot protection — Extra layer so sensitive chats stay off the screen. A hidden chat app experience by design.
• No push notifications — We don’t send notifications, so your usage stays as private as possible.
• Self-destructing messages — App that auto deletes messages after read. Built-in message auto delete, no manual steps.

💬 Use it for conversations that shouldn’t stick around

Secret chat app for couples — share a code only you two know, messages disappear, no notifications on lock screen. Private chat app for work — sensitive feedback, salary discussions, one-off decisions that shouldn’t live in email or Slack. Quick secure chat with a colleague — share a code, they scan, you’re in and done. A burner chat app for a temporary chat room that disappears — no account, no history, just a code.

🔄 How it compares

Signal requires a phone number and stores messages locally by default. Telegram secret chats need an account and a self-destruct timer. Snapchat is social-first with friends lists and ads. SimpleX has no user IDs but conversations persist. No Trace Chat skips all of that: no phone number, no account, no stored messages, no metadata. Messages vanish on read by default. The best disappearing messages app for conversations that should not exist after they happen. A stealth chat app that works without leaving traces.

🚀 No screenshots. No paper trail. No trace.

We don’t store your messages after they’re read. Code-based entry means only people you share the code with can join. No account means no profile to leak. Best for private conversations, anonymous chat, secure messaging, and anyone who wants a private messenger without an account.

Free on Android and iOS. Download No Trace Chat and start a private room in seconds. Share a code. They scan. You’re in. No trace.
shortDescription: Disappearing messages. Encrypted, no phone number, no signup. Join by code/QR.
